sentences.zh: 当丈夫告诉我他为什么第一次投票给民主党人时，他的妻子在背景里不停地大喊，不让录音。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: No problem.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for your time.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: In fact, when all of these cable news channels and newspapers come knocking at the Democratic Party door of Chris Stanley.
sentences.zh: 事实上，当所有这些有线新闻频道和报纸都来敲克里斯·斯坦利的民主党大门时。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: I have had a local ABC, NBC, CBS who's here, CNN, Inside Edition.
sentences.zh: 我接待过当地的ABC、NBC、CBS，还有CNN和《Inside Edition》栏目。

sentences.en: Looking for one of these supposedly hundreds of switch voters who will talk on the record.
sentences.zh: 他们都在寻找那几百个据称会公开表态的摇摆选民。

sentences.en: And how many people do you have you can send them to?
sentences.zh: 那你现在能把他们介绍给多少人？

sentences.en: I had only one for the longest time.
sentences.zh: 很长一段时间里我只有一个。

sentences.en: Now I have three.
sentences.zh: 现在我有三个了。

sentences.en: She doesn't have a lot to offer them.
sentences.zh: 她能提供给他们的并不多。

sentences.en: It's pretty tense right now.
sentences.zh: 现在气氛相当紧张。

sentences.en: And it's only getting tenser.
sentences.zh: 而且只会越来越紧张。

sentences.en: She says there are some obvious consequences to coming out with a Biden vote in the villages.
sentences.zh: 她说在“村庄”社区公开支持拜登会有一些显而易见的后果。

sentences.en: You might find that beer has been poured all over your golf cart.
sentences.zh: 你可能会发现你的高尔夫球车被泼满了啤酒。

sentences.en: Pretty bad vandalism.
sentences.zh: 相当严重的破坏行为。

sentences.en: One man with a Biden sign in his front window reportedly woke up to the word Trump written out in weed killer on his perfect lawn.
sentences.zh: 据报道，一名在前窗贴着拜登竞选标语的男子，一觉醒来发现自家完美的草坪上被人用除草剂写上了“特朗普”三个字。

sentences.en: And that's, you know, that's long-term expensive damage.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那是长期的、昂贵的损失。

sentences.en: But the personal consequences might be even more insidious.
sentences.zh: 但个人层面的后果可能更阴险。

sentences.en: In the current climate, if you were a Trump supporter and now you are not, it affects your social life.
sentences.zh: 在当前的环境下，如果你曾经是特朗普的支持者，而现在不是了，这会影响你的社交生活。

sentences.en: We're very active people here.
sentences.zh: 我们这里的人非常活跃。

sentences.en: And we're very social.
sentences.zh: 而且我们非常爱社交。

sentences.en: And if you come out publicly against Trump, you might need to find a new golf game.
sentences.zh: 如果你公开反对特朗普，你可能得重新找人打高尔夫了。

sentences.en: Have you seen this happen?
sentences.zh: 你见过这种情况吗？

sentences.en: I have seen it happen.
sentences.zh: 我见过。

sentences.en: And it's sad.
sentences.zh: 这很可悲。

sentences.en: They weren't welcome to the club anymore.
sentences.zh: 他们不再受欢迎了。

sentences.en: They lost their friends.
sentences.zh: 他们失去了朋友。

sentences.en: You know, their entire social group went away.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们整个社交圈都没了。

sentences.en: Politics is part of your makeup here for a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 对很多人来说，政治是这里生活的一部分。

sentences.en: You know, you got white hair and you wear a size six shoe and you're a Republican.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你头发花白，穿六码的鞋，那你就是共和党人。

sentences.en: I mean, it's all part of who you are.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这都是你身份的一部分。

sentences.en: Politics is ingraining people here.
sentences.zh: 政治已经深入人心。

sentences.en: I mean, this is my point about the villages.
sentences.zh: 这就是我关于“村庄”社区的观点。

sentences.en: Everybody wants to go talk to people there and they all talk to one person.
sentences.zh: 每个人都想去那里采访，但他们采访的都是同一个人。

sentences.en: And I don't know how much that tells you.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这能说明什么。

sentences.en: My colleague Patty, the veteran Florida reporter, had been advising me against focusing on the villages.
sentences.zh: 我的同事帕蒂，那位资深的佛罗里达记者，一直建议我不要把重点放在“村庄”社区。

sentences.en: You know, it's become a big political reporting cliche in this state, which is that you go to the villages to talk to older voters.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这在这个州已经成了一个政治报道的陈词滥调，就是去“村庄”社区采访老年选民。

sentences.en: So just to be clear, you're calling my decision to report in the villages a cliche?
sentences.zh: 所以明确一下，你是在说我决定去“村庄”社区报道是陈词滥调？

sentences.en: An understandable one.
sentences.zh: 一个可以理解的陈词滥调。

sentences.en: You know, the golf cart caravans are hard to resiSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，高尔夫球车队确实很难抗拒。

sentences.en: I don't blame you, Annie.
sentences.zh: 我不怪你，安妮。

sentences.en: I don't blame you.
sentences.zh: 我不怪你。

sentences.en: I blame me.
sentences.zh: 我怪我自己。

sentences.en: Though even Patty was moved by the weed killer.
sentences.zh: 尽管连帕蒂也被除草剂事件触动了。

sentences.en: I don't even know what to say.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道该说什么。

sentences.en: I don't know where to start.
sentences.zh: 我不知道从何说起。

sentences.en: That there was in 2016 that there was a shy Trump voter.
sentences.zh: 2016年的时候，确实存在“害羞的特朗普选民”。

sentences.en: And how there are some Democrats in Florida who have said, oh, this year there is a shy Biden voter.
sentences.zh: 而现在佛罗里达州的一些民主党人说，哦，今年有“害羞的拜登选民”。

sentences.en: But I had never heard it put in the terms of the people who don't want Trump written in weed killer in their lawns.
sentences.zh: 但我从未听说过用那些不想让草坪被除草剂写上“特朗普”的人来定义这种现象。

sentences.en: It's sort of wild.
sentences.zh: 这有点疯狂。

sentences.en: Do you think it's worth paying attention to, this elusive, shy Biden voter?
sentences.zh: 你认为这种难以捉摸的“害羞的拜登选民”值得关注吗？

sentences.en: I do because you have to try to look at it from all the possibilities of what could happen when you're a reporter, right?
sentences.zh: 我认为值得，因为作为一名记者，你必须尝试从所有可能发生的情况去观察，对吧？

sentences.en: And so if you have polls suggesting that older voters, retirees, seniors, are shifting politically in some way, we have a responsibility to go find out who they are,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果民调显示老年选民、退休人员、长者在政治立场上发生了某种转变，我们有责任去找出他们是谁，

sentences.en: where they are, and what that can tell us about the country and the election.
sentences.zh: 他们在哪里，以及这能告诉我们关于这个国家和这场选举的什么信息。

sentences.en: She just didn't want to find them in the villages.
sentences.zh: 她只是不想在“村庄”社区找他们。

sentences.en: She wanted to go to another Republican enclave, three hours south, called Lee County, which is still very conservative, but not as conservative as the villages.
sentences.zh: 她想去另一个共和党据点，在南边三小时车程的地方，叫李县，那里依然非常保守，但没有“村庄”社区那么保守。

sentences.en: The villages went for Trump by about 40 percent.
sentences.zh: “村庄”社区以大约40%的优势支持特朗普。

sentences.en: Lee County by about 20.
sentences.zh: 李县大约是20%。

sentences.en: Patty thinks that if Biden is gaining any traction there, that's probably more representative of trouble for Trump.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂认为，如果拜登在那里能获得任何支持，那可能更能代表特朗普的麻烦。

sentences.en: Lee County is in southwest Florida, and that is one of the areas that we have seen in recent election cycles has really helped Republicans get elected,
sentences.zh: 李县位于佛罗里达州西南部，这是我们在最近几届选举周期中看到确实帮助共和党人当选的地区之一，

sentences.en: in part because people vote in such high numbers.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是人们的投票率非常高。

sentences.en: Remember, Trump only won in 2016 by a little over 100,000 votes.
sentences.zh: 记住，特朗普在2016年仅以10多万票的优势获胜。

sentences.en: So any sort of erosion or slippage in his support in a place like this can add up and become a big deal if it happens statewide.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果他在这样一个地方的支持率出现任何侵蚀或下滑，一旦发生在全州范围内，就会积少成多，成为一件大事。

sentences.en: But how would it feel on the ground?
sentences.zh: 但在实地感觉会如何呢？

sentences.en: Like, do you expect that a place like Lee County, you'd be able to feel that erosion just, like, out in the streets?
sentences.zh: 比如，你觉得在李县这样的地方，你能在大街上感觉到这种侵蚀吗？

sentences.en: No, you would not be able to feel Biden's support out in the streets of Lee County.
sentences.zh: 不，你无法在李县的大街上感觉到拜登的支持率。

sentences.en: So then how do you look for it?
sentences.zh: 那你要怎么寻找呢？

sentences.en: You start asking everybody you know, do you know anybody who switched their vote from 2016 to 2020?
sentences.zh: 你开始问你认识的每一个人，你认识任何从2016年到2020年改变投票意向的人吗？

sentences.en: When we got to Lee County.
sentences.zh: 当我们到达李县时。

sentences.en: OK, my name is Francis Rooney, and I'm the congressman for District 19 in Florida, which basically is the western part of Lee and Collier counties.
sentences.zh: 好的，我叫弗朗西斯·鲁尼，我是佛罗里达州第19选区的国会议员，基本上就是李县和科利尔县的西部地区。

sentences.en: We called on its representative to help point us in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 我们请这位代表帮我们指明正确的方向。

sentences.en: And tell me about your district, Congressman.
sentences.zh: 议员，跟我说说你的选区吧。

sentences.en: Well, it's a very interesting district.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一个非常有趣的选区。

sentences.en: It's obviously a lot of coastline.
sentences.zh: 显然它有很长的海岸线。

sentences.en: It has a lot of retired people, as you might expect.
sentences.zh: 正如你所料，这里有很多退休人员。

sentences.en: There's an area called Cape Coral, which is a lot of retired people, almost all retired, very high number of retired people.
sentences.zh: 有一个叫开普科勒尔的地方，那里有很多退休人员，几乎全是退休人员，退休人员比例非常高。

sentences.en: A lot of from the upper MidweSt.
sentences.zh: 很多人来自中西部北部。

sentences.en: And then you have Sanibel and Captiva, which are more wealthier retired people.
sentences.zh: 然后是萨尼贝尔和卡普蒂瓦，那里住着更富有的退休人员。

sentences.en: And then you move south into Fort Myers, you've got some retirement homes and gated communities.
sentences.zh: 再往南到迈尔斯堡，有一些养老院和封闭式社区。

sentences.en: Then you go south into Naples and you get a lot of retired senior management of companies, some ambassadors, some admirals, generals, a lot of retired CEOs.
sentences.zh: 再往南到那不勒斯，你会遇到很多退休的公司高管、一些大使、海军上将、将军，还有很多退休的首席执行官。

sentences.en: There's just a little bit of everything.
sentences.zh: 这里什么人都有。

sentences.en: It's a very diverse district.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常多元化的选区。

sentences.en: Congressman Rooney says his constituents are classic conservatives.
sentences.zh: 鲁尼议员说他的选民是典型的保守派。

sentences.en: Bread and butter, traditional Republican values of thrift, limited government, defending life.
sentences.zh: 核心的、传统的共和党价值观，即节俭、有限政府、捍卫生命。

sentences.en: Those are very important as well.
sentences.zh: 这些也非常重要。

sentences.en: Did you describe it as staunchly conservative?
sentences.zh: 你把它描述为坚定保守吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: The loyalty to President Trump in our area is very strong.
sentences.zh: 我们地区对特朗普总统的忠诚度非常高。

sentences.en: So it's not necessarily tactical or issue centric.
sentences.zh: 所以这不一定是基于策略或议题的。

sentences.en: It's just strong loyalty to him.
sentences.zh: 这只是对他强烈的忠诚。

sentences.en: I think for some people, the fact that older voters would stick by the president,
sentences.zh: 我想对一些人来说，考虑到新冠病毒对美国老年人的健康、安全和生命造成了不成比例的影响，老年选民仍会支持总统，这令人困惑。

sentences.en: given the sort of disproportionate impact that the coronavirus has had on older Americans' health and safety and their lives, that it's confusing.
sentences.zh: 那么你的选民对此怎么说？

sentences.en: So what do your constituents tell you about that?
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们不怪他。

sentences.en: Well, they don't blame him.
sentences.zh: 他们一点也不怪他。

sentences.en: They don't blame him for it at all.
sentences.zh: 我问他怎么看这种“害羞选民”的说法。

sentences.en: I asked him what he thinks about the idea of this shy voter.
sentences.zh: 有很多传言说这里的老年选民正在背离总统。

sentences.en: A lot of the talk is that older voters here are turning on the president.
sentences.zh: 你在李县看到这种情况了吗？

sentences.en: Do you see that happening in Lee County?
sentences.zh: 不，我在李县没看到这种情况。

sentences.en: No, I don't see it happening in Lee County.
sentences.zh: 这可能发生在州的其他地方。

sentences.en: It may happen in other parts of the state.
sentences.zh: 那你认为关于拜登正在争取大量老年选民的报道是被夸大了，还是只发生在其他地方？

sentences.en: So do you think that the reports that Biden is peeling off a significant number of older voters, do you think they're overblown or they're just happening elsewhere?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我只能代表我的地区发言。

sentences.en: Well, I can only speak for my area.
sentences.zh: 我认为在我的地区，这种说法被大大夸大了。

sentences.en: I think that would be vastly overblown in my area.
sentences.zh: 我得亲自去看看。

sentences.en: I'd have to look for myself.
sentences.zh: 在李县的开普科勒尔选举中心，这里排着长队。

sentences.en: It's a long line here at the Cape Coral Election Center in Lee County.
sentences.zh: 人们穿着背心。

sentences.en: People are in tank tops.
sentences.zh: 他们穿着人字拖。

sentences.en: They are in flip-flops.
sentences.zh: 我们有坐轮椅和用助行器的选民。

sentences.en: We have voters in wheelchairs and in walkers.
sentences.zh: 很多特朗普的帽子。

sentences.en: Lots of Trump hats.
sentences.zh: 很多灰胡子。

sentences.en: Lots of gray beards.
sentences.zh: 很多摩托车。

sentences.en: Lots of motorcycles.
sentences.zh: 你属于65岁及以上的类别吗？

sentences.en: Do you fall into the 65 and above category?
sentences.zh: 我76岁了，11月16日生日。

sentences.en: I'm 76, November 16th.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 那你绝对是了。

sentences.en: So you solidly do.
sentences.zh: 你符合条件。

sentences.en: You've cleared it.
sentences.zh: 符合条件。

sentences.en: Cleared it.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 我能问问你今天投给了谁吗？

sentences.en: Can I ask who you voted for today?
sentences.zh: 特朗普。

sentences.en: Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普。

sentences.en: Trump.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·J·特朗普。

sentences.en: Donald J.
sentences.zh: 你在2016年也投给他了吗？

sentences.en: Trump.
sentences.zh: 绝对投了。

sentences.en: Did you vote for him in 2016 as well?
sentences.zh: 当然，鲁尼议员对他的选区判断是对的。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎假新闻怎么说。

sentences.en: Of course, Congressman Rooney was right about his district.
sentences.zh: 我们一定会赢。

sentences.en: I don't care what the fake news says.
sentences.zh: 我们一定会赢。

sentences.en: We are going to win.
sentences.zh: 我们一定会赢。

sentences.en: They're sticking with the president.
sentences.zh: 他们依然支持总统。

sentences.en: Because Trump is the king of the king.
sentences.zh: 因为特朗普是王者中的王者。

sentences.en: They don't blame him for the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 他们并不因为这场疫情而责怪他。

sentences.en: Like Donald Trump said, it came from China.
sentences.zh: 就像唐纳德·特朗普所说，病毒来自中国。

sentences.en: So he had no control over it.
sentences.zh: 所以他对此无能为力。

sentences.en: So they're doing the best they can with what they have.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们正尽其所能利用现有条件应对。

sentences.en: Can't pin it on the president or anybody else.
sentences.zh: 没法把这事怪在总统或其他任何人头上。

sentences.en: It's China.
sentences.zh: 是中国的错。

sentences.en: All these rules.
sentences.zh: 所有这些规定。

sentences.en: I agree there's a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我承认确实有疫情。

sentences.en: But I think in this case, it's kind of overblown.
sentences.zh: 但我认为在这种情况下，有点小题大做了。

sentences.en: Do you find that people in your community are starting to question the president?
sentences.zh: 你发现你社区里的人开始质疑总统了吗？

sentences.en: The people I know, no, not at all.
sentences.zh: 我认识的人没有，完全没有。

sentences.en: And they don't know anyone who is switching their vote from Trump to Biden.
sentences.zh: 而且他们也不认识任何从特朗普转投拜登的人。

sentences.en: You've seen, do you know people who have switched their votes from Trump to Biden?
sentences.zh: 你见过，或者说你认识从特朗普转投拜登的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't know of anybody that's within our circle that has.
sentences.zh: 在我们圈子里，我没听说有谁这么做。

sentences.en: And then Patty called.
sentences.zh: 然后帕蒂打来了电话。

sentences.en: Annie, we found one.
sentences.zh: 安妮，我们找到了一个。

sentences.en: She said she might have found a guy.
sentences.zh: 她说她可能找到了一个人选。

sentences.en: Either I give you an address or can we meet him?
sentences.zh: 我是给你地址，还是我们去见他？

sentences.en: He's 77 years old.
sentences.zh: 他今年77岁。

sentences.en: He lives in a retirement community.
sentences.zh: 他住在一个退休社区里。

sentences.en: And his name is Dave.
sentences.zh: 他叫戴夫。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能让你免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 这一个月你可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能读到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Do you want to do the tour first?
sentences.zh: 你想先参观一下吗？

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.zh: 哦，我们在我的凉廊上。

sentences.zh: 我当时也是其中的一部分。

sentences.zh: 这就是我成长的方式。

sentences.en: Just how I was brought up.
sentences.zh: 然后玛丽让我改过自新了。

sentences.zh: 戴夫的妻子是他多年来转变的关键。

sentences.en: Dave's wife is sort of key to his transformation over the years.
sentences.zh: 他说，不像他母亲，她不怕表达自己的想法。

sentences.en: Unlike his mother, he says, she wasn't afraid to speak her mind.
sentences.zh: 比方说，我带老板回家吃晚饭。

sentences.zh: 他会说些什么之类的。

sentences.en: And you'd go, oh, my God.

sentences.zh: 她只会拍我的后脑勺，你知道，让我清醒一点。

sentences.en: She just slapped me on the side of the head, you know, and get with the program.
sentences.zh: 戴夫说，在他们的婚姻中，有那么一个时刻，他别无选择，只能改变。

sentences.en: Dave says there came a point in their marriage when he had no choice but to change.
sentences.zh: 她终于态度强硬起来了。

sentences.en: She finally put her foot down.
sentences.zh: 我知道我有一个选择，要么学会变得更体贴，要么我就失去她。

sentences.en: And I knew that I had a choice of either learning how to be more sensitive or I wouldn't have her anymore.
sentences.zh: 那真是一个巨大的觉醒，我告诉你。

sentences.en: And that was a big awakening, I'll tell you.
sentences.zh: 所以发生了一场演变。

sentences.en: So there was this evolution that took place.
sentences.zh: 我几乎和我刚结婚时完全不同了。

sentences.en: I am almost nothing like I was when we first got married.

sentences.en: But by 2016, Dave was still not evolved enough, by his own calculation, to vote for Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 你知道，希拉里，我可能根本不知道她的纲领是什么，她的政策有多好。

sentences.en: You know, Hillary, I probably didn't have the vaguest idea what her programs were, how good of policies she had.
sentences.zh: 我从来没听过那些。

sentences.en: I never listened to those.

sentences.zh: 看起来，嗯，他一定是个成功的商人。

sentences.zh: 在特朗普执政大约一年后，戴夫一天早上去看她。

sentences.en: And she had passed away in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 她已经在半夜去世了。

sentences.zh: 她去世时，我觉得我有责任继续成长，继续保持敏锐，我欠她这些。

sentences.en: Does that make any sense?

sentences.zh: 你看，我妻子从未停止过教导我。

sentences.zh: 所以，我每天都在向她学习，尽管她已经不在了。

sentences.zh: 我花了很多时间看电视和新闻。

sentences.zh: 每当有关于总统的报道时，他看的时候都会在心里和玛丽交流。

sentences.zh: 我知道她会怎么想。

sentences.zh: 你知道，我能听到她的声音。

sentences.en: So, pretty quickly, Dave is regretting his vote.
sentences.zh: 所以，很快，戴夫就开始后悔自己的投票了。

sentences.zh: 他对自己所看到的移民问题感到不安。

sentences.zh: 所有这些越境而来的人，他们拆散了家庭。

sentences.zh: 他为弹劾程序感到困扰。

sentences.en: That, to me, was just totally unforgivable.

sentences.zh: 我大概能忍受大多数事情，甚至是他做的那些性丑闻之类的。

sentences.zh: 或者玛丽会怎么想。

sentences.en: Do you miss Mary when you, when you're kind of working through these, these tensions?
sentences.zh: 当你，当你正在处理这些，这些紧张关系时，你会想念玛丽吗？

sentences.en: Oh yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: More than, more than you could know.
sentences.zh: 比，比你能想象的还要想念。

sentences.en: Um, big part of my life is gone.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我生命中很重要的一部分消失了。

sentences.en: And, uh, yeah, I keep looking for it.
sentences.zh: 而且，呃，是的，我一直在寻找它。

sentences.en: It's hard to say how representative Dave is.
sentences.zh: 很难说戴夫有多么具有代表性。

sentences.en: For him to have made such a dramatic shift, guided by the memory of his late wife.
sentences.zh: 他能做出如此巨大的转变，是在他已故妻子的记忆引导下。

sentences.en: I don't think we can say that it's representative.
sentences.zh: 我不认为我们可以说这是有代表性的。

sentences.en: I think we can say that if Biden is going to have a chance in this state, then he is going to need a lot of people like Dave.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们可以说，如果拜登想在这个州有机会，那么他将需要很多像戴夫这样的人。

sentences.en: But in conversations with six of these Trump-to-Biden switch voters in Florida,
sentences.zh: 但在与佛罗里达州六位从特朗普转向拜登的选民交谈中，

sentences.en: I did hear some consistent themes.
sentences.zh: 我确实听到了一些一致的主题。

sentences.en: That they hated Hillary more than they liked Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们讨厌希拉里胜过喜欢特朗普。

sentences.en: That they were well on their way to switching their vote by the time the pandemic rolled around.
sentences.zh: 在疫情来临时，他们已经在转向投票的道路上了。

sentences.en: In fact, if Biden had been the nominee in 2016,
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果拜登是2016年的候选人，

sentences.en: perhaps they would have been tempted to vote for him then.
sentences.zh: 也许他们那时就会被诱惑去投票给他。

sentences.en: As Patty says, this is a specific type of switch voter in Florida.
sentences.zh: 正如帕蒂所说，这是佛罗里达州一种特定类型的转向选民。

sentences.en: They are people who, if they voted for Trump, did so with serious reservations already.
sentences.zh: 他们是那些如果投票给特朗普，也是带着严重保留意见的人。

sentences.en: And in some cases, they didn't vote for him.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，他们根本没有投票给他。

sentences.en: They voted third party sort of in proteSt.
sentences.zh: 他们以抗议的方式投给了第三方。

sentences.en: And then seeing the Trump presidency was sort of their final thread connecting them to the party.
sentences.zh: 然后看到特朗普的总统任期，这算是他们与该党联系的最后一根线。

sentences.en: So either they left the party or the party left them.
sentences.zh: 所以要么他们离开了党，要么党抛弃了他们。

sentences.en: But they were already sort of on the verge or getting close to that when they voted last time.
sentences.zh: 但他们上次投票时，就已经处于边缘或接近那个状态了。

sentences.en: But we both think there's a second type of switch voter in places like Lee County.
sentences.zh: 但我们都认为在李县这样的地方还有第二种类型的转向选民。

sentences.en: I think there's also a sort of old school Republican who would still describe themselves as a conservative
sentences.zh: 我认为还有一种老派的共和党人，他们仍然会称自己为保守派，

sentences.en: and say that it's the president who is not a conservative in the way that they see the old mold of the party.
sentences.zh: 并说总统在他们所看到的旧党派模式中并不是一个保守派。

sentences.en: It's just even harder to know how many of these voters there are.
sentences.zh: 要了解这类选民有多少人就更难了。

sentences.en: And those might be even shyer voters in terms of telling you how they think, because they're not ready to abandon the party that they have been a part of for a long time.
sentences.zh: 而且他们可能在表达自己的想法方面更加害羞，因为他们还没有准备好放弃他们长期以来所属的政党。

sentences.en: They sort of feel like this is perhaps an interlude of Trump, but that they still believe, for example, in talking about budget deficits and fiscal conservatism.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得这可能只是特朗普的一个插曲，但他们仍然相信，例如，谈论预算赤字和财政保守主义。

sentences.en: And they're not really sure where to go or if they have a political home in this election.
sentences.zh: 他们真的不知道该去哪里，或者在这次选举中是否还有一个政治归宿。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: People are going to be writing books about this situation for years.
sentences.zh: 人们多年来都会写关于这种情况的书。

sentences.en: While I was in Florida, Congressman Rooney, who is himself retiring this year, was attracting some attention in his district.
sentences.zh: 当我在佛罗里达州时，今年即将退休的鲁尼众议员在他的选区引起了一些关注。

sentences.en: He had recently given an interview where he said that he thought Biden would do a better job than Trump in handling the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 他最近接受采访时说，他认为拜登在处理新冠病毒方面会比特朗普做得更好。

sentences.en: What he hadn't done, however, was announce that he would be voting for Biden.
sentences.zh: 然而，他还没有宣布他会投票给拜登。

sentences.en: So toward the end of our conversation, I started to ask him about this idea that social pressures might be preventing people in his district
sentences.zh: 所以在我们谈话快结束时，我开始问他关于社会压力可能正在阻止他选区的人们

sentences.en: from saying if they planned to switch their vote away from Trump.
sentences.zh: 说出他们是否计划改变对特朗普的投票意向这一想法。

sentences.en: You know, that's an interesting point.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一个有趣的观点。

sentences.en: I think that it's so intensely partisan and emotionally charged right now, the whole issue of the election, that there are probably more people
sentences.zh: 我认为现在选举的整个问题是如此强烈地党派化和情绪化，以至于可能有更多的人

sentences.en: that don't want to say how they're going to vote now than there ever were.
sentences.zh: 不想说他们现在打算怎么投票，比以往任何时候都多。

sentences.en: They just don't want to say what they're going to do because they're going to get criticized by somebody in their family or their neighborhood or something.
sentences.zh: 他们只是不想说他们要做什么，因为他们会受到家人、邻居或其他人的批评。

sentences.en: You know, you just don't want your neighbor screaming and yelling at you when you pull out of your driveway.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你只是不想当你开车离开车道时，邻居对你大喊大叫。

sentences.en: I also wonder about how particularly strong the social consequences are here in a place where people have come to retire.
sentences.zh: 我也想知道，在一个人们退休后居住的地方，社会后果有多么严重。

sentences.en: And so the majority of their life is spent socializing and being with friends and family.
sentences.zh: 所以他们大部分的生活都花在社交和与朋友家人在一起上。

sentences.en: Do you think that I'm onto something there with the sense that like here, it might be even harder to come out with a different opinion because of...
sentences.zh: 你认为我关于在这里可能更难表达不同意见的看法有道理吗，因为……

sentences.en: Well, I definitely think you're right about that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我绝对认为你说得对。

sentences.en: These people, a lot of them, they're retired.
sentences.zh: 这些人，他们中的很多人，都已经退休了。

sentences.en: They have a lot more time to spend with their friends, to spend in eating and drinking and playing golf and doing things with people.
sentences.zh: 他们有更多的时间和朋友在一起，花在吃喝、打高尔夫球和与人交往上。

sentences.en: And so it increases the cost of having someone get mad at you.
sentences.zh: 所以这增加了让别人生气的代价。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You could actually not have anything to do tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 你明天可能真的没事可做。

sentences.en: Might not find a golf game.
sentences.zh: 可能找不到球局。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So we are mere days away from the election.
sentences.zh: 所以距离选举只有几天了。

sentences.en: Have you decided who you're voting for?
sentences.zh: 你决定好投给谁了吗？

sentences.en: Well, every day is a new day in this thing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这件事每天都是新的一天。

sentences.en: I'll decide when I go in there a couple of days before the early voting ends next week, late next week.
sentences.zh: 我会在下周，下周晚些时候提前投票结束前的几天去投票时再决定。

sentences.en: What information are you waiting for?
sentences.zh: 你在等待什么信息？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: So you don't have any idea who you're going to vote for when you go in there?
sentences.zh: 所以你进去的时候根本不知道要投给谁？

sentences.en: I haven't really thought about it.
sentences.zh: 我还没怎么想过。

sentences.en: What do you have to lose in terms of not divulging where you are in the process?
sentences.zh: 如果不透露你在过程中的想法，你有什么损失？

sentences.en: Like, why not?
sentences.zh: 比如，为什么不呢？

sentences.en: Probably nothing.
sentences.zh: 可能没什么。

sentences.en: But, you know, I just kind of think voting privately is a sacrosanct right.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我只是觉得私下投票是一项神圣不可侵犯的权利。

sentences.en: It's worth noting that Rooney publicly endorsed Mitt Romney in 2012 and Donald Trump in 2016.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，鲁尼在2012年公开支持米特·罗姆尼，在2016年支持唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: I just don't want to say.
sentences.zh: 我只是不想说。

sentences.en: I've said a lot of things that I think about the candidates.
sentences.zh: 我已经说了很多我对候选人的看法。

sentences.en: I've said a lot of things I think the vice president is really strong on.
sentences.zh: 我已经说了很多我认为副总统非常强的地方。

sentences.en: And that he's a really good guy, a decent human being.
sentences.zh: 而且他是个很好的人，一个正派的人。

sentences.en: And I met him a few times.
sentences.zh: 我见过他几次。

sentences.en: And his key people are really good people.
sentences.zh: 他的核心团队都是很好的人。

sentences.en: And that's probably enough to say.
sentences.zh: 说这些大概就够了。

sentences.en: You know, you're a lifetime conservative.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你是一个终身的保守派。

sentences.en: You're retiring to your home district filled with Republicans who are likely to vote for a president who represents some stuff that you don't agree with.
sentences.zh: 你退休回到你的家乡选区，那里充满了可能投票给一位代表了你不同意的东西的总统的共和党人。

sentences.en: And even if you're not running for re-election, it seems to me like you might have something on the line here.
sentences.zh: 即使你不再竞选连任，在我看来，你在这里似乎也有所牵挂。

sentences.en: Something that's more like your identity or your place in the community.
sentences.zh: 更像是你的身份或你在社区中的地位。

sentences.en: Oh, sure.
sentences.zh: 哦，当然。

sentences.en: There's risk to stepping out of any of this stuff, especially as polarized as we are.
sentences.zh: 走出这一切都有风险，尤其是在我们如此两极分化的情况下。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, it's uniquely monolithic right now about this president.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，现在关于这位总统的情况非常单一。

sentences.en: So do you feel some of that same pressure we were talking about of, like, losing friends, losing your place?
sentences.zh: 那么你是否感觉到我们刚才谈到的那种压力，比如失去朋友，失去你的位置？

sentences.en: No, I don't think I will.
sentences.zh: 不，我不认为我会。

sentences.en: But there will be people that are going to say, wow, you should have been closer to the president, should have done some of the good.
sentences.zh: 但会有一些人说，哇，你应该更亲近总统，应该做点好事。

sentences.en: Yeah, there'll be some of that.
sentences.zh: 是的，会有一些这样的声音。

sentences.en: Like Doris, the godmother of the Lee County Republicans.
sentences.zh: 就像李县共和党的教母多丽丝那样。

sentences.en: She's told him explicitly,
sentences.zh: 她明确告诉他，

sentences.en: get out.
sentences.zh: 滚出去。

sentences.en: Well, thank you, Congressman Rooney.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢你，鲁尼议员。

sentences.en: Okay, thank you.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: All right, bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 好的，再见。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: The Times reports that the number of new coronavirus infections in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，美国新冠病毒新增感染人数

sentences.en: is now averaging more than 75,000 a day, a record high that is fueling calls for a national mandate to wear masks.
sentences.zh: 目前平均每天超过7.5万人，创下历史新高，这引发了要求全国强制佩戴口罩的呼声。

sentences.en: As of Thursday, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 截至周四，美国

sentences.en: had surpassed 9 million infections since the start of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 自疫情开始以来，感染人数已超过900万。

sentences.en: I think it will be easily by the end of 2021 and perhaps even into the next year before we start having some semblances of normality.
sentences.zh: 我认为到2021年底，甚至可能要到下一年，我们才能开始恢复某种程度的正常生活。

sentences.en: And it really depends.
sentences.zh: 这真的取决于具体情况。

sentences.en: During an appearance on Thursday, the White House's top pandemic advisor, Dr. Anthony Fauci,
sentences.zh: 在周四的一次露面中，白宫首席疫情顾问安东尼·福奇博士

sentences.en: said that the virus would continue to disrupt American life until at least the end of next year, and blamed states for reopening too rapidly.
sentences.zh: 表示，病毒将至少在明年年底前继续扰乱美国人的生活，并指责各州重启速度过快。

sentences.en: It really depends on what you mean by normal.
sentences.zh: 这真的取决于你所说的“正常”是什么意思。

sentences.en: I mean, if normal means you can get restaurants to open at almost full capacity, if you could have sporting events to be able to be played with spectators,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果“正常”意味着餐馆几乎可以满负荷营业，如果体育赛事可以有观众入场，

sentences.en: either in the stands or in the arena, then I think that's going to be well, well into 2021 and perhaps beyond.
sentences.zh: 无论是在看台上还是在场馆内，那么我认为那要等到2021年很晚的时候，甚至可能更久。

sentences.zh: 我想其中一件事……

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台受到严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。
